question: Do domain-adapted models have useful complementary errors once unobserved classes are protected, and is label-availability-aware protection better than strong static protection?
evidence: In seed17 the only two class6 service measurements are in rounds3 and7. No class6 feedback is available before either prediction; the first label arrives after round7. Current observer and fixed-midway get both right; every tested augmented model loses them. Source has74 class6 examples. Existing snapshots permit genuine frozen inference without retraining.
candidates: For each of the four augmented models, use fixed-midway as old capability. Unseen-class rule: retain backbone if either its predicted class or the adapted predicted class has zero feedback labels so far, else use adapted. Historical-region rule: use adapted only if its cumulative prequential correct-minus-backbone count in the region defined by the backbone predicted class is strictly positive, else retain backbone. Ties retain backbone. No fitted thresholds, no class6 hardcoding.
strong_controls: Same model bank, original observer, existing fixed-midway, all four always-augmented predictions, each fixed protected class1..6 per augmented model (retain backbone whenever either prediction belongs to that class), and equal geometric mean of each augmented model and its backbone. Static protected-class results are development-selected strong controls; do not call their gains runtime autonomy. If a simple new static composition wins, retain it as a tool candidate and identify the class-specific nature of that result.
execution: Replay13 existing development draws, original service and32-feedback clock, no last-round labels. Verify each old accepted payload and snapshot digest. Reload actual frozen model parameters to reproduce original service forecasts and to generate feedback predictions before revealing their saved labels. Submit each new service output before update. Verify feedback IDs, disjointness, available label count and original field/base scores. No new training or model service. Hindsight row oracle between backbone and each augmented model is diagnosis only.
decision: Report final Macro-F1 and per-class recall for seed17 and draw mean. Keep the original0.02 worst-class-recall protection. Identify best adaptive and best static separately. Any new composition exceeding the prior strongest fixed mean and current default while satisfying recall may advance to integration and frozen independent validation. Claim autonomy only if adaptive also beats the strongest same-bank static control. If no competitive composition exists, close this bank and move away from routing it.
budget: One of the four remaining authorized phase CPU jobs, <=300sec. Up to the remaining three jobs are reserved for necessary integration, independent validation or repairs if a route is promising. No new training, external model service, platform run or submission.
